title: Special Weather Statement by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
1 hours ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-07-15 20:33:00 PDT Expires: 2026-07-15 21:00:00 PDT Urgency: Expected Severity: Moderate Certainty: Observed Instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building. Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways. Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm. Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe shelter inside a building or vehicle. Target Area: Northeastern Nye County At 833 PM PDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 14 miles south of Duckwater, moving north at 20 mph.
HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Heavy rainfall along with gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible.
Locations impacted include... Duckwater.
